review_scope: Admission to the bounded 190-step pilot only; not certification of extreme quality or downstream improvement.
review_method: Read head and middle excerpts for 40 hash-priority documents in each of web, DCLM, code, and both math segments; reviewed revised-sample additions and kept failed prior versions.
recipe_revision_before_first_backward: Both branches use provenance-restricted educational web with int_score >= 3; only source proportions and narrative differ.

observations.web: Final excerpts are coherent institutional, reference, scientific, and historical prose. Some abstracts, course descriptions, related links, catalog material, and historical OCR remain. No assertion that every sentence is correct or every item is a full lesson.
observations.dclm: Broad news, discussions, culture, everyday topics and opinions are retained. Explicit glossary/pornographic matches were removed. A historical-pub article replacing a rejected sample was reviewed; ordinary historical references are not treated as erotic content.
observations.math: Sources are traceable forums, academic sites and references. Autogenerated forum summaries and obvious notation-loss templates were excluded. Student mistakes and subsequent corrections, references to absent figures, and unresolved discussions may remain.
observations.code: Recognizable source code, tests, and examples. Upstream permissive-license and educational-score gates retained. Some comments and string literals are not English. This is not a repository execution or formal code-correctness audit.

limitations: Excerpt audit by the assistant, not a separate human review or calibrated semantic classifier.
Hash-priority document sampling is not a token-weighted full-corpus correctness estimate.
Provenance restrictions introduce source/topic bias and may exclude good independent writing.
Dedup and contamination filters are not exhaustive semantic/paraphrase checks.
Original 20B weights and 30 percent original train replay are preserved, not retrospectively cleaned.
Pilot B still needs narrative admission and small shared-pool refills; this receipt authorizes A only.
No claim of surpassing TinyLlama before frozen downstream evaluation.
